text:
alex: 6hr flight tomorrow — need one album + one short book to keep me awake but not fried. Instrumental or cozy sci-fi preferred. Recs? :airplane: :headphones: :book:
mai: Ooh. Album: Nils Frahm — 'Spaces' (live). Short book: Nicholson Baker — 'The Mezzanine' (weirdly calming).
jordan: If you want non-lullaby but steady: Explosions in the Sky — 'The Earth Is Not a Cold Dead Place' + 'The Slow Regard of Silent Things' (short & odd).
sam: For something offbeat: Kaitlyn Aurelia Smith — 'EARS' (synthetic but warm). Book: 'The Emperor's Soul' by Brandon Sanderson (100 pages, excellent).
lina: Recommend an ambient field-recording playlist — search 'soundwalks' on Spotify. Also 'St. Lucy' by Lucy Corin is short weird fiction if you like creepy-cozy.
devon: I curate a flight mixtape — want me to throw one together? :smiley:
alex: @devon please! also prefer no huge crescendos, so maybe avoid Explosions if it peaks too hard.
devon: Gotcha. Will do a low-dynamics set: Julianna Barwick, Hammock, Goldmund, Nils Frahm. Playlist link in 2m.
spotify-bot: Playlist created: https://open.spotify.com/playlist/37i9dQZF1DX4sWSpwq3LiO ("Flight: Low Dynamics") :sparkles:
mai: Also pro tip — audiobook mini-collections are great for dozing between film glare and naps. If you want paperback, 'The Mezzanine' or 'The Emperor's Soul' are perfect. :thumbsup:
